title: A Noisy Morning
story: Leo woke up before his alarm because someone was drilling in the flat above. The noise started, stopped, and started again. He put a pillow over his head, but he could still hear it. At seven he got up and made tea. The drilling did not stop. Leo did not want to shout. He wrote a short note that said the noise began very early. He went upstairs and knocked on the door. A woman called Nora opened it with dust on her hands. She looked sorry at once. She said she was putting up a shelf before work and did not know the sound was so loud. Leo showed her the note and pointed at the time. Nora turned off the drill. She promised to wait until nine the next day. Leo thanked her and went back downstairs. His flat was quiet again. He drank his tea and packed his bag. Before he left, Nora slipped a second note under his door. It said she would finish the shelf at the weekend, after nine. Leo smiled. A calm talk had worked better than anger. He opened the window and heard only a bird in the yard. The shelf could wait until a kinder hour.
